provenance.method: Fresh full-file identity, read-only ID0 complete regions, IDAPython/raw-ID1 byte equality, gap-free Capstone x86-32 decode. Recovery parser only avoids unused large zero preallocation; no native code executed. IAT metadata does not certify runtime values.

helper.troopLifetime: Save first argument before validity; use current storage of the same troop pointer after any full-frame/RNG effect query. True unknown08 continues to the direct setter even if callback replaced the frame or vtable. False retains callback changes and skips the store. Missing reached storage is an explicit gap.
helper.forceLifetime: Never recompute the earlier saved EBX force from troop ownership or current/reset raw44; the saved force pointer remains unchanged.

raw44.description: The signed argument admits exactly -1 or 0..46. The admitted value is stored as one DWORD; no existing stored-value range is implied. Existing raw44 uses a full signed32 representation and -1 denotes exactly 0xffffffff bits, without a new inferred gameplay meaning.

validity.unknown08: Ordered full-frame/RNG effect-query, with saved troop pointer and exact continuation. A missing reached row is an explicit gap, never a null/invalid conversion.

boundary.temporaryObject: Caller message-object bytes remain in stack storage. Argument cleanup proves neither destruction nor absence of aliasing or asynchronous retention. The reset helper and setter have no read of that local; later consumers of unrepresented temporary/formatter state remain open.

semantics.platform: Fixed readable canonical slots and successful unchanged read/write pointer probes; no event-argument/control-stack/saved-local corruption, native SEH or concurrency certification.
excluded: global RNG, runtime, clean-stock, Vanilla and console certification
